title: Module Flow Map
purpose: Show how site modules connect from tracking to sourcing, review, forecasting and findings.
boundary: Modules separate routes, records, signals, forecasts and findings. Public pages should not upgrade beyond the available record grade.

flow.name: Track
flow.job: List people, institutions, layers, records and links.

flow.name: Source
flow.job: Define record routes and route limits.

flow.name: Forecast
flow.job: Turn signals into provisional scenario probabilities.

flow.name: Publish
flow.job: Show graded findings, limits and next records.

rule: A public finding should trace backward through finding, scenario, signal, record card, source route and original record.
nextAction: Check build and deployment errors, then confirm generated pages update.
